taxpayer_name.rationale: HouseholdEmployerNm maps directly to the household employer's name printed at the top of Schedule H.

taxpayer_ssn.rationale: SSN maps to the taxpayer's Social Security number in the top identifier block of Schedule H.

employer_ein.rationale: EmployerEIN maps to the Employer Identification Number shown in the top identifier block.

cash_wages_paid_over_threshold.rationale: HsldEmplPdCashWageOverLmtCYInd is the indicator for whether cash wages over the threshold were paid in the current year, matching Part I Line A.

ss_wages.rationale: SocialSecurityTaxCashWagesAmt maps to Part I Line 1, total cash wages subject to Social Security tax.

ss_tax_withheld_employee.rationale: No candidate specifically represents the employee's share of Social Security tax withheld (Line 2); SocialSecurityTaxAmt appears to represent the combined/employer share rather than the employee withholding amount alone — cannot match without ambiguity.

ss_tax_employer.rationale: SocialSecurityTaxAmt is the closest match for the employer share of Social Security tax (Line 3), though the schema may bundle both shares; best available candidate.

medicare_wages.rationale: MedicareTaxCashWagesAmt maps to Part I Line 4, total cash wages subject to Medicare tax.

medicare_tax_withheld_employee.rationale: MedicareTaxWithheldAmt maps to Part I Line 5, employee Medicare tax withheld.

medicare_tax_employer.rationale: No candidate specifically represents the employer share of Medicare tax (Line 6) separately from the withheld employee amount; the schema does not appear to split this value out.

additional_medicare_tax_withheld.rationale: AddnlMedicareTaxWithholdingAmt maps directly to Part I Line 7, Additional Medicare Tax withheld.

total_ss_medicare_tax.rationale: TotSocSecMedcrAndFedIncmTaxAmt maps to Part I Line 8, total Social Security and Medicare taxes.

federal_income_tax_withheld_part_i.rationale: FederalIncomeTaxWithheldAmt maps to Part I Line 9, federal income tax withheld from household employee wages.

total_taxes_before_adjustment.rationale: TotMedcrTaxCashWagesAddnlWhAmt maps to Part I Line 10, total taxes before adjustments (Lines 8 plus 9).

advance_eic_payments.rationale: No candidate in the canonical list corresponds to advance EIC payments (Line 11); this field has been removed from recent Schedule H revisions and is not present in the MeF schema.

net_taxes_part_i.rationale: CombinedFUTATaxPlusNetTaxesAmt is the closest available candidate for the net household employment taxes from Part I (Line 12), though it may combine FUTA; best available match.

futa_cash_wages_over_threshold.rationale: HsldEmplPdTotCashWageAnyQtrInd is the indicator for whether total cash wages of $1,000 or more were paid in any quarter, matching Part II Line B.

futa_state.rationale: StateCd under UnemplFundSingleStateGroup maps to Part II Line C, the single state to which SUTA was paid.

futa_state_contributions_paid.rationale: UnemplPaidOnlyOneStateInd is the closest indicator for whether state unemployment contributions were paid, corresponding to the Part II state payment checkbox.

futa_state_contributions_on_time.rationale: PayAllStateUnemplContriInd maps to the Part II checkbox for whether all state unemployment contributions were paid on time.

total_futa_wages.rationale: TotalCashWagesSubjFUTATaxAmt under UnemplFundSingleStateGroup maps to Part II Line 13, total FUTA wages for a single-state filer.

futa_tax_before_adjustments.rationale: FUTATaxAmt under UnemplFundSingleStateGroup maps to Part II Line 14, FUTA tax before adjustments for a single-state filer.

maximum_futa_credit.rationale: FUTATaxCreditMaxAllowedAmt maps to Part II Line 15, maximum allowable FUTA credit.

futa_credit_reduction_amount.rationale: TotalUnemplAdditionalTaxCrAmt under UnemplFundMultiStateGroup maps to Part II Line 16, credit reduction amount from the FUTA Credit Reduction worksheet.

futa_credit.rationale: TentativeFUTACreditAmt maps to Part II Line 17, allowable FUTA credit after reduction.

net_futa_tax.rationale: FUTATaxAmt under UnemplFundMultiStateGroup maps to Part II Line 18, net FUTA tax after credit.

credit_reduction_states.rationale: UnemploymentStateTaxGroup is the repeating group element containing per-state credit reduction rows in the FUTA Credit Reduction worksheet.

federal_income_tax_withheld_required.rationale: HsldEmplFedIncmTaxWithheldInd maps to Part III Line D checkbox, whether federal income tax withholding was elected.

federal_income_tax_withheld_part_iii.rationale: The schema does not appear to have a separate element for Part III Line 19 federal income tax withheld distinct from the Part I Line 9 FederalIncomeTaxWithheldAmt; the blueprint should clarify whether these map to the same canonical element or if the schema merges them.

total_household_employment_taxes.rationale: TotalTaxHouseholdEmplCalcAmt maps to Part IV total household employment taxes carried to Schedule 2 of Form 1040.
